product: Thinking Machine Labs Inkling is scheduled for retirement
tagline: Thinking Machine Labs Inkling will be retired on October 30, 2026.
what_it_does: Thinking Machine Labs Inkling will be retired on October 30, 2026. GLM 5.3 and Kimi K3 are the recommended replacements. This page describes the model maintenance policy for the Foundation Model APIs pay per token, Foundation Model APIs provisioned throughput, Batch Inference with ai query, and Foundation Model Fine tuning offerings.
